note: Section 9.1, worked problems = none. On three one-sided fill-in-the-symbols items (keys H0 ≥/Ha < and H0 ≤/Ha >) entering H0 '=' with the correct Ha direction is now graded 'Correct.' with both blanks ticked. Grading is still strict where it should be: H0 '<', H0 '≠', H0 with the reversed inequality, Ha '=', and Ha reversed were each marked 'Not quite' (5 checks in 9.1).

Section 6.1, worked problems = none. Answered q1-q3, checked q3 without pressing Next, then reloaded, five times, with 0/30/300/1500 ms between the check and the reload. Every run came back at 'Question 3 of 10' with the same question, the three stored results ([true,true,true,null,...]) and the feedback box intact. A reload on the score screen kept '10 / 10 correct (100%)' instead of restarting the quiz.

worked problems = none now yields zero open/model-answer questions in all eight sections tried (1.1, 2.5, 8.1, 9.1, 11.2, 2.7, 12.3, 10.1). Two side effects of the fix are filed separately: 1.1 silently serves 8 questions when 10 were asked (short-test-silent) and 1.4, which has no instantly-checked items, now shows a bare 'no questions available for this scope' page (quiz-no-questions-dead-end). The opposite setting is still not honoured either ('only' — see worked-only-not-honoured).

Ten input forms tried on numeric questions in 6.1 and 7.2. Now accepted: trailing unit ('300 cm'), unit with no space ('0.7891cm'), '2 units', leading '+', a restated variable ('x = 173.5', 'y = 0.8413'), surrounding spaces, percentages, thousands separator ('1,000'). Still rejected, as in round one: comma decimal ('3888,5') and scientific notation ('8.0000e+2'). No leniency was introduced: clearly wrong values with a unit or an 'x = ' prefix, 'answer is 0.8186', and '0.0446 blah 99' are all still marked wrong.

'Retake with new questions' is now a link to a new seed. Verified on section quizzes 7.2 and 10.1 (seed 81027 -> 158566, 804733 -> 556601, templateShare/openShare kept) and on chapter quizzes 1, 3, 7, 11, 12. The new quiz starts at question 1 with no feedback showing, overlaps the old set by 0-2 questions, and reloading the retake URL restores that same new quiz.

'Choose an answer first.' now appears, both from the Check answer button and from Enter, on multiple choice, numeric and fill-in-the-symbols questions (six questions in 2.7 plus fill items in 9.1). The quiz does not advance and no answer is recorded.

The chosen option is now logged as its text: 'your answer: variable.', 'your answer: cluster', 'your answer: The mean, median, and mode are equal.' The correct answer on the same line still carries the shuffled letter ('correct: c. statistic.', 'correct: a. false'), which is the same stale-letter problem on the other half of the line; filed as mistake-log-correct-answer-letter.

Sections 3.4, 12.3 and 1.1: at a question that shares its scenario with the previous one, quitting to chapters and returning to the quiz URL, and reloading, both now show the scenario in full (no 'Same scenario as the previous question' line, no 'Show it again' button). Within one page load the collapse is still used even though the previous question is no longer on screen; filed as scenario-collapsed-with-no-previous.
A missed fill-in-the-symbols question now reads 'Correct answer: H0: μ =; Ha: μ ≠' — one colon per blank, no doubled colon. Seen on several 9.1 items with both two-sided and one-sided keys.

steps: Pick a learner on the home page
Open section 1.4 Experimental Design and Ethics (its own page says '10 questions ready · 0 checked instantly · 10 worked problems with model answers')
Leave questions at 10, set 'worked problems' to 'none'
Click Start quiz
expected: Either the 'none' option is not offered for a section with no instantly-checked questions, or the quiz starts with an explanation (e.g. 'this section has only worked problems') and a way back to the section.
actual: The quiz page contains the single line 'no questions available for this scope' and no controls at all — no Back, no Start quiz, no link to the section; the URL is #/quiz?scope=section&id=1.4&count=10&seed=...&openShare=0. The only escape is the header nav or the browser Back button. The learner chose a combination the section page offered and the core flow dies. Other sections with 0 auto-graded items but generators (2.1, 3.5, 11.5) are fine because templates fill the test.

steps: Pick a learner
Open section 1.1 (26 questions ready · 8 checked instantly)
Choose questions = 10 and worked problems = none
Click Start quiz and look at the counter, then finish the quiz
expected: A note that only 8 instantly-checked questions exist, so the test is shorter than the 10 asked for (round one asked for exactly this notice).
actual: The quiz silently becomes 8 questions: 'Question 1 of 8' ... score screen '8 / 8 correct (100%)'. Nothing says why, and the URL still reads count=10, so 'Print this test' from that score screen is built from count=10 as well. Reproduced in 1.1; other sections tested served the full 10.

steps: Pick a learner
Open section 8.1 (28 questions ready · 4 checked instantly · 24 worked problems)
Choose questions = 10 and worked problems = 'only'
Click Start quiz and walk through the questions
expected: 'only' means only worked problems, the mirror image of 'none' (which is now obeyed exactly).
actual: 4 of the 10 questions are instantly-checked template questions (kinds: open,open,open,numeric,numeric,mc,open,numeric,open,open; question 4 is numeric). The same 6-of-10 ceiling appears in 2.5, 2.7, 9.1, 10.1, 11.2, 11.5, 12.3 — every section that has generators — so 'only' behaves exactly like 'mostly'. In sections with no generators (1.1) 'only' does give 10 worked problems, which shows the setting is understood but overridden by the template share.

steps: Pick a learner, open section 3.4, worked problems = some, Start quiz
Answer questions until one shares its scenario with the question before it (e.g. the 'Seventy 5th and 6th graders' table)
Read the new question without clicking anything
expected: The scenario is shown in full, or the collapse is used only when the earlier question is still readable. The app shows one question per screen, so the previous question never remains on screen.
actual: The card reads 'Same scenario as the previous question. / Show it again' and then 'Find the probability that a child does not prefer pizza.' with options 30/70, 30/40, 40/70, 1. The table it refers to is gone from the screen; the learner has to click 'Show it again' (which does show the right table) for every such question. Round one's resume/reload cases are fixed, but the plain Next case still hides data the question needs.

steps: Pick a learner, take a chapter 1 quiz and answer some multiple-choice questions wrongly
Open Progress and read the mistake log entries
expected: Both halves of the line name the option text, since options are shuffled per quiz.
actual: 'your answer: variable. · correct: c. statistic.' and 'your answer: true · correct: a. false'. The learner's own answer is now the text (round one's complaint), but the correct answer still carries the letter from that quiz's shuffled order, so the two halves are in different formats and the letter means nothing later.

steps: Pick a learner, open chapter 7 and start a chapter quiz of 20
Answer every 7.3 question correctly and every 7.1 and 7.2 question wrongly
Open Progress and read the section table
expected: The per-section 'LAST QUIZ' figure reflects how that section went, or the column says it is the whole quiz's score.
actual: Every row shows the chapter total: '7.1 ... ANSWERED 6 CORRECT 0% LAST QUIZ 35%', '7.3 ... CORRECT 100% LAST QUIZ 35%'. A learner reading the 7.1 row sees 35% for a section they scored 0 on. Same in chapters 1, 3, 11 and 12 (all rows 53%, 60%, 60%, 70%).

steps: Pick a learner, open section 12.3, worked problems = only, Start quiz
On a worked problem type something in the workspace and press Ctrl+Enter (as the hint says) to reveal the model answer
Look at where the keyboard focus is and at the key-hint line
expected: Focus lands on 'I got it' (or the first self-mark button) and the hint says which key does what, as it now does after an instantly-checked answer (focus moves to 'Next question', hint 'Press Enter for the next question').
actual: Focus is dropped to <body> and the key-hint line is empty, so a keyboard learner has nothing to press and has to Tab to find 'I got it'. Pressing Enter in that state correctly does nothing (the round-one skip is fixed) and after clicking 'I got it' focus does move to 'Next question' with the right hint — only the self-mark step is left out.

steps: Pick a learner, open section 3.4, worked problems = some, Start quiz
Walk to question rv9-80 'Find the probability that a child does not prefer pizza.'
expected: A question whose four lettered options are on screen is checked by the app, like every other multiple-choice question.
actual: The options are printed as part of the stem ('a. 30/70  b. 30/40  c. 40/70  d. 1') under a free-text workspace with 'Show model answer'; the learner must grade themselves against the model answer 'c. 40/70' with 'I got it / I missed it'. Objectively checkable work is left to self-marking, and the mistake log then records 'marked as missed' rather than the option chosen. Noted only; content is audited separately.
